### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm frustrated when [...]"

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how the proposed feature fits into Aedile's Clean Architecture structure.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, code mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
